User Request: Orders per month in 1996

Dashboard Components:
Title: Orders per Month in 1996
Type: chart
Description: Trend of orders placed each month in 1996
Title: Monthly Order Count
Type: table
Description: Total number of orders per month in 1996
Title: Total Orders in 1996
Type: kpi
Description: Overall number of orders placed in 1996

sql_queries.title: Orders per Month in 1996
sql_queries.description: Trend of orders placed each month in 1996
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS OrderMonth, COUNT(OrderID) AS OrderCount FROM Orders WHERE strftime('%Y', OrderDate) = '1996' GROUP BY OrderMonth ORDER BY OrderMonth

sql_queries.title: Monthly Order Count
sql_queries.description: Total number of orders per month in 1996
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS OrderMonth, COUNT(OrderID) AS OrderCount FROM Orders WHERE strftime('%Y', OrderDate) = '1996' GROUP BY OrderMonth ORDER BY OrderMonth

sql_queries.title: Total Orders in 1996
sql_queries.description: Overall number of orders placed in 1996
sql_queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(OrderID) AS TotalOrders FROM Orders WHERE strftime('%Y', OrderDate) = '1996'
